salesCopy.problem: You've heard `Obsidian` is powerful. But every time you try to set it up, you hit the same wall: *where should notes go?* Which plugins matter? How do you structure this thing so it doesn't become another digital junk drawer? I've watched people spend **months** on this. Meanwhile, their ideas stay trapped in their heads or scattered across apps they'll never open again.
problemPoints: **Weeks spent** on folder structure, only to scrap it when things don't fit
Trying **dozens of plugins** without knowing which actually matter
Building templates from scratch that **break after 50 notes**
Reading contradictory PKM advice that makes you *more confused*
Watching your vault become **messier as it grows**
Reading books about *Zettelkasten*, *PARA*, *GTD* but **struggling to implement** them in practice
**Juggling multiple apps**: task managers, journaling apps, contact tools and note apps that never talk to each other
**Finished work piling up** next to what's still open, until your task list is more archive than plan
**AI tools that don't know you**: generic chatbots producing generic output, disconnected from your notes, your projects, and your thinking
salesCopy.agitate: The real cost isn't the setup time. It's the **constant anxiety** that important ideas are slipping through the cracks. It's the **creative blocks** when you can't find your own notes. It's feeling less capable than you should because your *'second brain'* is a disorganized mess. I spent years organizing information at scale, and mastered the art. I applied it to my Obsidian vault as well.
agitatePoints: That **nagging feeling** that you captured something important but can't find it
**Creative blocks** because your thinking is disconnected
**Analysis paralysis** from too many options and no clear path
Starting from scratch feels like reinventing the wheel. *Because it is.*
Your brain becomes the **only connection point** between scattered tools
**Lost connections**: You can't remember who introduced that idea, who you discussed it with, or what you learned from whom
**AI insights evaporating**: brilliant AI conversations lost the moment you close the tab, because they live outside your knowledge base
salesCopy.solution: OSK is the Obsidian vault I run my business from every day, without my personal content. It's **20+ years** of knowledge management trial and error, turned into a system that works **from day one**: journaling, actions, learning and creation, all connected. With **v5**, finished work files itself, the things you do every day are one click away, and you can see where your time really goes. The AI assistant system now looks up the skill it needs instead of loading all of them before you've typed a word, and it follows one rule: **AI augments your thinking; it never replaces it**. Every decision has been made for you, and you can still change any of them.

**Every commitment gets a home**: Activities for the work that never ends, Ideas for what you haven't committed to yet, and Kanban boards for all of it

**A full AI assistant inside your vault**: agents with memory, AI skills, LLM Wikis and a Personal Identity System. `Claude Code` gets all of it and finds skills on demand; `Codex`, `Gemini CLI` and `GitHub Copilot` get part of it

**AI that keeps you the thinker**: an identity layer that teaches AI who you are, source provenance for every claim, and review panels that catch generic output. AI does the plumbing; you do the thinking
**40+ templates** that file notes where they belong, so you stop thinking about organization
Scales from **10 notes to 15,000+**: my own vault runs on the same structure
**A deep online user guide** covering foundations, systems, theory, step-by-step tutorials and reference. You never get stuck.
**One system replaces many tools**: journaling, tasks, contacts, meeting notes and content creation, all connected
**Visual thinking built in**: Canvas and Excalidraw integration for non-linear thinking and spatial reasoning

originStory.title: Why I Built the Obsidian Starter Kit
originStory.subtitle: 20+ Years of Knowledge Management, Distilled
originStory.story: For over two decades, I've been obsessed with one question: How do we capture, organize, and use knowledge without losing our minds? I've tried every tool, every methodology, every system. I've failed spectacularly (many times) and refined relentlessly. Eventually, I learned my lessons and ended up with a solid system. A system that scaled from my first notes to 10K+, that grew with my career as an author, blogger, and entrepreneur, that made me more capable every single day. But it wasn't until I watched others struggle with the same chaos I had overcome (spending months recreating mistakes I'd already solved) that I realized this system needed to be shared. The Obsidian Starter Kit isn't a product I built to sell. It's the system I use every day, packaged so you don't have to spend years figuring it out yourself.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Watching talented people waste months on problems I had already solved

creatorJourney.title: My Journey Through Knowledge Chaos
creatorJourney.subtitle: From Scattered Notes to Systematic Mastery
creatorJourney.story: Before I had this system, I lived with constant background anxiety. Important ideas would slip away. I'd capture something brilliant and never find it again. My information was scattered across tools that never talked to each other. And I was the only connection point, relying on my memory to bridge the gaps. The creative blocks were the worst part. I knew I had the pieces, but I couldn't connect them. I felt less competent than I should have been, struggling to use my own thinking. Sound familiar? That's exactly why I spent years refining this system. So you don't have to. Today, I use OSK daily with AI tools like Claude, and my knowledge genuinely compounds. Every note I create makes me more capable. That's how I've been able to write hundreds of articles, newsletters, books, and share a [free public knowledge base](https://notes.dsebastien.net/) full of everything I've learned about knowledge management. That's what I want for you.

methodology.title: The OSK Philosophy
methodology.subtitle: Seven Principles That Make Knowledge Work

steps.title: Systems Over Willpower
steps.description: The system does the work, not your discipline or memory. Templates auto-file. Tags auto-organize. You focus on thinking, not housekeeping. When organization is automatic, consistency becomes natural.

steps.title: Opinionated But Flexible
steps.description: Every decision has been made for you. But nothing is locked. You get a complete, working system from day one with no analysis paralysis. As you learn, customize anything. But you don't have to customize anything to be productive.

steps.title: Built to Evolve
steps.description: OSK isn't static. It grows and adapts as your needs change, as new tools emerge, as AI gets better. Free lifetime updates mean your system evolves with you.

steps.title: Knowledge Compounds
steps.description: Every note should make you more capable, not just more organized. OSK is built around connecting ideas across time, projects, and domains. Your second brain should make your first brain smarter.

steps.title: AI Augments, Never Replaces
steps.description: You stay the author, curator, and decision-maker. AI handles the busywork: filing, linking, research legwork, first drafts. The identity layer, source provenance, and review panels keep AI output grounded in your notes and your voice. You can outsource the labor; you can't outsource your understanding.

steps.title: Documentation-Driven
steps.description: A deep user guide covers foundations, integrated systems, theory, step-by-step tutorials, and reference materials. You're never stuck wondering how something works or what to do next.

steps.title: One System, Many Tools
steps.description: OSK replaces fragmented apps with one integrated system. Your journaling connects to your tasks connects to your contacts connects to your knowledge. Information flows instead of getting stuck in silos.

methodology.philosophy: Most PKM systems fail because they require constant effort to maintain. OSK works because the system works for you, freeing your energy for what actually matters: thinking, creating, growing. The same stance drives the AI layer: AI removes the boring parts of knowledge work so your time goes to the parts that actually need a human. A vault written entirely by AI is a knowledge base with no knower; OSK is built to make sure that never happens to yours.
methodology.differentiation: Unlike templates that give you empty structures or tutorials that leave you to figure out implementation, OSK is a complete, working and battle-tested system. It is based on techniques I've refined and mastered over 20+ years. It's not theory. It's what I actually use every single day.

vision.title: Where This Takes You
vision.subtitle: The Future of Your Knowledge
vision.mission: Your knowledge should compound like interest. Every insight builds on the last, every note makes you more capable. OSK gives you that compounding advantage, whether you have 10 notes or 10,000. My goal is to help you become a systematic creator: someone who produces consistently, connects ideas naturally, and grows through their knowledge rather than drowning in it.

values.title: Clarity Over Complexity
values.description: A system should bring clarity, not add another layer of complexity. OSK simplifies knowledge work by making organization invisible.

values.title: Growth Over Perfection
values.description: Your system doesn't need to be perfect to work. OSK is designed for iteration. Start simple, evolve naturally.

values.title: Action Over Accumulation
values.description: Collecting notes is worthless if you never use them. OSK prioritizes retrieval, connection, and creation. Not just capture.

values.title: AI-Native, Human First
values.description: AI is changing knowledge work. OSK ships a full AI assistant system: agents, skills, LLM Wikis and an identity layer, and since v5 it loads only the skills a task needs. AI does the plumbing so you can do the thinking. Your vault stays yours; your thinking stays yours.

futureGoals: Help you reach 10,000+ notes with zero chaos
Let you write and create directly from your knowledge
Give you a real AI assistant: agents, skills and wikis that know your system and know you
Give you confidence that your system will serve you for life
vision.biggerPicture: In a world of information overload, the people who thrive are those who can capture, connect, and use knowledge systematically. OSK is your foundation for becoming one of them.
